# Vision 2040 — research and image notes

A school project by Manini Sharma. All proposed 2040 facilities are a student vision, not an announced plan or measured prediction. Checked 3 November 2026.

## Primary research

- DPS Mathura Road, existing infrastructure, smart classrooms, AI Innovation & Incubation Centre, ATL, libraries and sports: https://dpsmathuraroad.org/infrastructure.php
- Atal Innovation Mission, making with sensors, robotics, microcontrollers and 3D printing: https://aim.gov.in/atl-overview.php
- UNESCO, human-centred generative AI in education, teacher agency and privacy: https://www.unesco.org/en/articles/guidance-generative-ai-education-and-research
- US Department of Energy, zero-energy schools, efficiency and renewable generation: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/buildings/zero-energy-buildings-schools
- US Department of Energy, using CO2 and particulate monitoring to inform indoor air management: https://www.energy.gov/cmei/buildings/iaq-monitoring
- Apple, real assessment/single-app modes for managed learning devices: https://support.apple.com/en-us/101976
- Apple, school-owned shared learning devices: https://support.apple.com/en-ca/guide/deployment/dep9a34c2ba2/web
- NHGRI, genomics teaching activities including fruit DNA extraction: https://www.genome.gov/about-genomics/teaching-tools
- Smithsonian, classroom fruit DNA activities: https://www.si.edu/educators/science-resources

## From research to the proposal

Managed study tablets, assessment modes, digital notes, teacher-guided AI, digital microscopy, solar roofs, rainwater management and sensor projects are plausible directions grounded in existing technologies. The specific combinations, campus design, 2040 date and suggested roadmap are creative proposals. No numerical energy savings, learning gains or implementation costs are claimed.

School solar and water upgrades would need building and site assessment. Delhi air management requires attention to outdoor particles as well as indoor CO2. AI is proposed as teacher-approved support. Digital assessments should retain appropriate accessibility options. DNA learning is about supervised educational samples, not testing students. Robots support human educators in this vision.

## Images and assets

Original photos/video supplied in the parent Manini folder were left unchanged. Optimized copies are in assets/originals. The science reference was extracted at 00:04 from ScienceLab.mp4. Five AI-assisted future concepts were created using those references:

- campus: the recognizable curved facade, twin towers, solar roof and landscaped grounds.
- classroom: collaborative learning tables, shared displays and teacher-led learning.
- lab: the Atal lab reimagined as a practical makerspace.
- science: the real science-room layout with digital microscopy and supervised instruments.
- sports: the basketball court with solar shade and coaching tools.

AI imagery is illustrative, not an architectural survey; details may differ from the real building. Full PNG masters stay local in assets/concepts/*-master.png. The web page uses compressed WebP and smaller mobile variants. The dance image is the supplied present-day photo. The tablet, plane and rotating campus schematic are code-created, not third-party stock.

## Motion inspiration

User reference: https://github.com/DhvanilPatel/swarm-cursors
Original inspiration credited by that repository: https://califa.github.io/swarm/

The repository was reviewed for the interaction concept only. No extension installed and no source code copied. This project's swarm.js is an original canvas implementation: deterministic per-tile dismantling and rebuilding, with illustrated cursor workers. It reverses with native scrolling. The paper-plane companion follows the scroll story. The page does not capture or track the visitor's mouse.

## Visual revision

The final image set was regenerated following user review to show a coeducational school: boys and girls, and male and female teachers. The art direction was revised toward ordinary documentary school photography, restrained practical renovations, neutral light, familiar furnishings and lived-in surfaces. The earlier more stylised image set is archived locally under work/, not served by the site.

## Vision 2040 infrastructure revision

Following review, the final concepts show major visible upgrades, photographed realistically: solar canopies, external shading and accessible glass lift; digital collaborative classroom surfaces, shared lesson screens and AR study stations; guarded robotics, additive manufacturing and digital-twin workstations; digital microscopy, adjustable science islands and enclosed lab automation; covered solar sports infrastructure, physical video coaching screens and ball-return practice equipment. These are proposed facilities, not existing DPS installations. Mixed-gender students and male and female staff are retained.
